scale.basis: Ø200 disc, vanes on an R60 true-centre arc (faces R56.2 and R63.8), vane ends at 85.5 / 46.6 / 7, heights 31 and 30, Ø60.3 hub top, rim thickness 3, M12x1.25 24 deep

frame: origin at the disc centre on the flat bottom face, Z up toward the vane tops, X to the right in the top view
body: base disc Ø200, 3 thick at the rim, z 0..3
top face rising as a shallow cone (stands in for R800) from z=3 at r=100 to z=11 at r=33
central hub: a frustum from r=31 at z=10 to Ø60.3 at z=30 (2° draft)

6 curved vanes (thin walls, not bosses), z 0..31, 7.6 thick: faces R56.2 / R63.8 about a true centre (25.6, 49.2) on an R60 arc. Each runs from its inner end at (46.6, -7) to the Ø200 rim at x=85.5. They are 6x equally spaced by rotation about the disc centre and clipped to Ø200

features.source: M12x1.25-6H - 24 DEEP, drilled from the flat bottom (tap drill 10.2)

guessed: Vane arc centre (25.6, 49.2) was computed from an R60 arc through the inner end (46.6, -7) and the rim point (85.5, 51.9)
Plate thickness of 11 at the hub was measured from the section scale
Hub base radius of 31 was estimated from the 2° draft
The R800 surface is approximated as a cone
The R4 and 2 mm fillets and the 30° vane-tip draft are omitted
